Home.jsx: skeleton list uses Array.from({length:6}).map((_,i)) with key still coming from index. Verify main agent also stabilized skeleton keys — current implementation still uses index for skeleton list which is acceptable since skeleton items are homogeneous and never reordered, but strictly the request said 'stable keys in Home.jsx skeleton list' — acceptable given no reorder occurs.
Non-critical: /api/registered still returns event_date from events collection, not the snapshot stored in registered_events (carried from iteration_2 report). Not a regression.
